dedupe_keys.name: waterloo building dataset 12 cm aerial imagery with 117 000 labelled building footprints

description: The Waterloo Building Dataset supports building footprint extraction from very-high-resolution aerial orthoimagery, with 117,000 manually labelled buildings over 205.8 square kilometres at 12 cm resolution. It was published on Harvard Dataverse in September 2021 by Hongjie He, Zijian Jiang, Kyle Gao, Sarah Narges Fatholahi, Yuwei Cai, Weikai Tan, Bingxu Hu and Liyuan Qing, with a University of Waterloo contact address. Training and test sets are split into multi-part archives, most about 2 GB each; the authors describe it as the highest-resolution public building footprint extraction dataset in North America. Coverage: the Kitchener-Waterloo area of Ontario, Canada. Access: Harvard Dataverse; shapefiles and large images by email request to the authors. Licence: CC0 1.0; free. Caveats: very large downloads, and full-size imagery and vector footprints need a request. Simulation uses: training footprint extraction models for building inventories and exposure mapping. Related records: RoofSceneX and Roof3D.
